role: Online activist, blogger, and political commentator
contribution: Arif Jebtik was an online activist and commentator whose writing and public interventions placed him within Bangladesh's secular and Shahbag-era digital political sphere.
context: His public activity unfolded amid the 2013 war-crimes justice protests, counter-mobilization, and an increasingly hostile environment for bloggers. Accounts of the period also describe him as a practicing Muslim who challenged attempts to equate Shahbag activism with a single religious identity.
impact: Jebtik represents the role of digital commentators in shaping the Shahbag debate and contesting simplified narratives about secularism, religion, and political belonging.
highlight: Online commentator who became a visible voice in the contested digital politics around Shahbag.
seoTitle: Arif Jebtik: Blogger and Shahbag-Era Commentator

shortAnswer: Arif Jebtik was a Bangladeshi blogger and online commentator active in the digital political debates surrounding Shahbag.

faq.answer: He is an online activist and commentator associated with the digital political debates around Shahbag, secularism, and war-crimes justice.
